metadata.fidelity: composite task-selected workspace copies and provider-native computer client protocol for supported model/tool-version pairs; native shell is disabled and this is not evaluator or desktop-VM parity
metadata.workspace_safety: no config-level workspace is set; each task must select a frozen repository outside the output tree so manifests, evaluator answers, and prior artifacts are not copied into the agent workspace
metadata.shell_safety: allow_native_shell is false; run_command checks executable names against the allowlist and resolves them through a fixed trusted PATH, but python3 and other interpreters remain arbitrary-code capabilities and require an outer sandbox
metadata.network_safety: allowed_hosts constrains requested top-level navigation only; redirects, subresources, and pixel-entered URLs require an outer egress boundary
